purpose: Expose the smallest phase-sensitive measurement law that would have to be physically justified; not an implemented experiment, PAH consequence or complete new microscopic model.
hypothesis: An independently motivated causal physical instrument J_r couples a phase-coherent reference and probe to the existing PAH link field, gives an original-law-preserving marginal (or a separately authorized controlled disturbance treatment), and synchronizes its outcomes to a calibrated laboratory clock through a justified map t_r. No such J_r is supplied or adopted.

logical_interface.phase_gate: For a fixed configuration x and face p, the proposed target is C_p(x)=|0><0| + U_p(x)|1><1| on reference/path arms. This is an abstract desired response, NOT a derived physical Hamiltonian.
logical_interface.readout_definition: For output Y in {-1,+1}, phase theta, independently known b_p and 0<V_p<=1 with |b_p|+V_p<=1: E[Y|x,p,theta]=b_p+V_p Re(exp(i theta) U_p(x)). Equivalently P(Y=+1|x)=(1+b_p+V_p Re(exp(i theta)U_p(x)))/2.
logical_interface.calibrated_reconstruction: At theta=0, p^(-1) sum_faces (E[Y|x,face,0]-b_face)/V_face = W(x). A sample mean is an estimator, not an exact single-shot value. Face weights remain equal AFTER individual calibration.
logical_interface.reference_requirement: A reference arm or equivalent phase reference is essential; scalar multiplication of a single isolated amplitude leaves its population unchanged.
logical_interface.scope: This conditional readout kernel only illustrates what a physical instrument must realize. It does not give probe-U dynamics, t_r, noninvasiveness, source identification or a temporal prediction.

timing_and_backaction.lab_time: One traceable laboratory reference timestamps both settings and detections; offsets and synchronization covariance across all face measurements must be fixed. No vertex clock is chosen.
timing_and_backaction.external_time_map: t_r(tau) must be causal, justified independently of W decay and pinned before scoring. Not supplied; no rate multiplier or new time law is chosen.
timing_and_backaction.finite_exposure: A real interferometer acts over an interval. Its time-ordered probe evolution must imply the displayed instantaneous kernel with a justified error, or its exact exposure functional must be declared without changing the target silently.
timing_and_backaction.original_law: The joint instrument marginal on background trajectories must agree with the original PAH path law in the declared norm or supply a controlled error compatible with the target. A changed physical law requires separate approval. Outcome-conditioned posterior updating is not itself physical backaction.
timing_and_backaction.synchronization: Sequential face or phase measurements at different times/configurations do not automatically reconstruct instantaneous global W or its two-time correlation.
timing_and_backaction.no_stationarity_shortcut: Original Gibbs stationarity cannot be assumed after conditioning, time sampling or coupling.

refinement.scope: Existing fixed finite carrier and r-first limits only; no new h,N,epsilon,volume or continuum limit.
refinement.requirements: Identify the same apparatus, region, duration and equal-face averaging as r changes, including error and calibration transport. Integer labels or CRT maps alone supply no physical transport.
refinement.emulator_firewall: Programming probe control phases from a computed PAH trajectory is an encoded simulator. It tests that encoding, not the presence of PAH variables in nature.

calibration_and_holdout.calibration: Before any PAH-dependent signal: determine reference phase, per-face b,V, clock offsets, exposure and nuisance covariance using independent standards/settings. No numerical calibration values chosen here.
calibration_and_holdout.uncertainty: Use a joint covariance and controlled nonadiabatic, finite-exposure, disturbance, synchronization and drift remainders. No independence or bounded error is presumed.
calibration_and_holdout.holdout: Only after a physical instrument and calibration are admitted: freeze settings, scorer, model predictions, uncertainty, original ensemble and unused outcome acquisition. Public source examples are retrospective design, not holdout.
calibration_and_holdout.two_time_target: A future separately admitted test may target E_pi[W_r(X_(t_r(tau1))) W_r(X_(t_r(tau2)))], after deriving the relation to the actual instrument outcomes. This is an unevaluated interface, not an available prediction.
calibration_and_holdout.static_vs_dynamic: Static sensitivity can be admitted without nonzero time variation. Shot noise and device drift do not constitute W dynamics; R-575/R-576 stay as applicable controls.

approval_boundary.allowed_now: Source comparison, this unadopted target contract, and algebra/metadata controls only.
approval_boundary.requires_separate_authorization: Selecting a physical probe interaction, adding a Hamiltonian/coupling/rate/time/state law, changing the background marginal or regulator interpretation, implementing or scoring that new version.
approval_boundary.not_authorized: Silently adopting the displayed kernel or an H_int proportional to W as a PAH-derived law.
falsifiers: The response does not depend on the original U but only on externally programmed phases.
Response weights yield energy-weighted or contrast-weighted loop averages rather than W.
Time or sensitivity is selected to undo R-576 or after holdout disclosure.
Coupling/exposure changes the background law beyond the declared controlled treatment.
The same apparatus/refinement comparison or calibrated phase reference cannot be specified.
approval_boundary.next_single_question: Can a source-supported physical J_r filling this interface be supplied without redefining the original PAH model, or explicitly proposed and separately authorized as an extension?

non_claims: No implemented coupling, operational PAH time, experimental data, empirical exclusion or physical identification
No new theorem/no-go, dynamics, Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, GR, continuum, mass gap or TOE
